summary: Correctly resolves the issue by applying the supplied `formats` to columns' `info.format` before HTML serialization, matching how other ascii writers pick up formatting. Approach is reasonable and tests pass; only minor concerns around in-place column mutation and a spurious no-op diff hunk.

issues.description: Mutates `col.info.format` on the live table columns in place. If the write path does not operate on a copy, the caller's table retains the changed format after write(), a subtle side effect. Likely acceptable/consistent with existing behavior but worth noting.
Diff includes a no-op hunk (`yield col_str` -> identical `yield col_str`), adding noise with no functional change.
No changelog/docs entry shown; a user-facing behavior fix normally warrants a changelog note (may be omitted from diff).
